subject: Marine Works - Tadoussac to Pointe à Michel - Rivière du Loup
text:
Marine Works - Tadoussac to Pointe à Michel - Rivière du Loup
Dredging operations taking place 24 hours per day, 7 days a week at the Rivière-du-Loup wharf beginning 05 Oct 2026. Dredge, barges and tugs on site.
Minimum wake requested.
